strengths: Strong type system provides excellent compile-time safety
Good use of discriminated unions for type safety

concerns.concern: Error handling could be more consistent across the codebase
Missing null safety checks in several public APIs

recommendations.title: Implement consistent error handling pattern
recommendations.problem: Error handling is inconsistent - some functions throw, others return Result types
recommendations.current_approach: Mixed error handling strategies across codebase
recommendations.proposed_approach: Standardize on Result<T, Error> type for recoverable errors, throw for programmer errors
recommendations.rationale: Improves predictability and makes error handling explicit in type signatures

recommendations.title: Add runtime null checks for public APIs
recommendations.problem: TypeScript null checking doesn't catch runtime null values from external sources
recommendations.proposed_approach: Add explicit null validation at API boundaries with helpful error messages
recommendations.rationale: Prevents runtime crashes and provides better error messages to users

questions.question: What is the expected behavior when a null value is passed to the streaming API?
questions.context: Need clarification on error handling strategy for invalid inputs

questions.question: Should we prioritize backwards compatibility or correct error handling?
questions.context: Fixing error handling may require breaking changes to public API
